Magento-to-Shopify Migration Proposal

iCubes — Shopify Migration Proposal

Client: iCubes (icubes.co.uk) — PC hardware retailer (NUCs, gaming/AI PCs, mini PCs, components)
Prepared by: LitOS/LitGroup
Date: August 4, 2026
1

Proposed scope

1.1 Platform

Migrate from Magento (confirmed live) to Shopify.

1.2 Complex product handling — reference products

Two live products illustrate the technical scope of this migration:

Shuttle XPC Slim DH810 (configurable product):

  • Tech Spec — currently a linked PDF file (confirmed live), a single product-level attribute. Standard migration imports the file name into metafields only; uploading the actual file and linking it into metafields, plus the theme customization to display it on the front-end, is custom work.
  • Video tab — a YouTube video-link attribute, already imported into Shopify. Displaying it on the front-end needs custom theme work.
  • Bundle/options — the product is a bundle; its sub-items import as options linked to a simple product.

Gigabyte Brix Twin Lake Mini PC:

  • Each option has its own PDF file attachment — needs custom option handling plus custom file handling, and custom theme work to display on the front-end.
Important update on the options app: the app originally suggested for the bundle/options work, Aris Product Options, was removed from the Shopify App Store on August 3, 2026 and can no longer be installed. Recommend SC Product Options (Shop Circle — the successor to the well-known Bold Product Options) instead: 4.6★, 1,197 reviews, supports file-upload option fields (PDF and other formats) and CSV import/export for bulk-migrating option data from Magento. Pricing: Basic $14.99/mo, Premium $39.99/mo (adds conditional logic, swatches, cart-page editing).

Bundle functionality is achievable with this approach — bundle layout will not be a 100% visual match to the current site.

1.3 Design & UX improvements

In scope for Quote 2 only (see Section 2):

Header

  • Replace "Sign In" / "Create an Account" text links on the topbar with an account icon next to the cart icon.
  • Move search to the center of the header.
  • Reduce logo size.
  • Menu bar background in blue or black.
  • Remove the dropdown chevron from menu items that don't have a submenu — only show it where a submenu actually exists.
  • Hero banner images become clickable links.

Homepage

  • Current homepage is short — the new homepage surfaces collections.
  • Add a product section (tabbed Best Seller / New Product / Hot Deals, each card with Buy Now + Add to Cart).
  • Add a trust/service section (e.g. Free & Fast Shipping, Easy Returns, Quality Guarantee, Technical Support).
  • Add a banner-combined-with-product section — a lifestyle banner with embedded mini product cards showing price + View Details.
  • Remove duplicate banner images that already appear in the hero slider, so the same product photos aren't repeated in a static banner right below.

Hero style references:

Footer

  • Shrink the footer icons — currently oversized.
  • Restructure to a cleaner layout: newsletter signup bar, multi-column link groups (Shop / Info / Policies / Contact), social icons, payment method icons.

Two footer layout references:

Product card

  • Two reference styles to draw from: a light card with a Sale badge, strikethrough price + "From $X" in red, and a pill-shaped Quick Add button; or a dark-themed card with a savings badge and both Buy Now + Add to Cart buttons.

Collection page

  • Add filters — price, brand, and similar facets.
